body.policeEvidence: When you experience a crime, the police might have to take things that belong to you to help them with the investigation. Some things might also be used as evidence in the court trial.
body.propertyBack: You are usually able to have your property back when the case ends and there's no appeal. You do not have to take it back.
heading.howToGet: How to get your property back
body.askOfficer: When the case ends, you can ask the police officer in charge of your case for your property back.
body.collectProperty: They will ask you to come to your local police station to collect your property. You will need to bring personal ID, for example your driving licence or passport.
heading.contactOfficer: Contact the police officer in charge
body.noContactDetails: If you do not have the contact details of your police officer in charge or local police force, contact the police by phone or online.
link.contactPoliceOnline: Contact the police online (opens in new tab)
